summary: Frontend-only mandatory retest executed on public preview URL. Core interactions were revalidated, but required menu routing behavior is still broken and timeline wheel lock regressed at camera level.

ui_bugs.issue: Menu link clicks do not reliably move camera to target node; Timeline/Cars/Victories repeatedly stay off-target (often ORIGIN).
Mouse wheel while on TIMELINE moves spatial camera to CARS (active-node-2 -> active-node-3), so timeline camera lock requirement is not met.

integration_issues.flow: Fresh menu matrix + sequential menu matrix
integration_issues.issue: Mandatory routing matrix still fails from menu interactions despite direct window.__spatialGo('timeline', { immediate: true }) succeeding in same session.

action_items: Fix menu click-to-route determinism so Legacy/Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories always activate the intended spatial node on both fresh and sequential runs.
Ensure menu route invocation is guaranteed after panel interaction (avoid race/no-op path where HUD remains ORIGIN after click).
Keep TIMELINE camera locked against wheel-based camera movement while preserving timeline next/previous arrow functionality.
Re-run mandatory matrix after fixes: fresh-per-link + sequential + gallery buttons + timeline lock + quote/victory regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav routing still exhibits non-deterministic behavior under real interaction timing; current delayed invocation approach is not sufficient in production preview behavior.

Observed state mismatch: after menu Timeline click, viewport class remains active-node-0 (HUD ORIGIN), while direct __spatialGo immediately sets active-node-2. This indicates menu-path invocation failure/race rather than route-stop mapping failure.
Timeline wheel currently changes spatial node even when timeline year itself stays unchanged; camera-lock expectation is violated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PASS: direct spatial routing to gallery/timeline/quotes/victories works; gallery next/previous now moves strip (0 -> 1155 -> 0); home logo returns to origin; quote next updates text; victories year filter updates count; no console errors; no horizontal overflow. FAIL: mandatory menu matrix still fails for multiple links from actual menu clicks; timeline wheel moves camera from TIMELINE to CARS.
rca of the issue: Reproduction (menu): load page, open menu, click Timeline (or Cars/Victories). Expected target node full-screen, but HUD often remains ORIGIN and viewport class stays active-node-0. In same run, direct window.__spatialGo('timeline', {immediate:true}) correctly sets active-node-2 and centers timeline, indicating the route map itself is valid. Reproduction (timeline lock): go to timeline via direct route, wheel down once; HUD changes TIMELINE -> CARS while timeline year text remains unchanged. Mitigation direction: enforce a single deterministic menu routing path that confirms node activation post-click, and gate/consume wheel input while timeline node is active so camera state cannot advance to adjacent sections.
